versions.subject: Add rule create files by Microsoft Sync Center
versions.detection:
selection_mobsync:
    Image|endswith: 'mobsync.exe'
filter_created_file:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        - '.dll'
        - '.exe'
condition: selection_mobsync and filter_created_file
